name: tabs
title: Tabs
purpose: Switch between related local or filtered result panels without navigating away, with compact responsive navigation and square underline geometry.
avoidFor: Content users need to compare simultaneously
accessibility: Implements tablist, tab, and tabpanel roles.
Left, Right, Home, and End keys move focus among enabled tabs without consuming vertical page-scrolling keys.
Each tab is linked to its labelled panel.
Non-tile tab lists scroll horizontally when their labels exceed the available width without exposing a cross-axis scrollbar.
commonMistakes: Hiding essential comparison content in separate panels.
Rendering filtered results outside the associated tab panel.

examples.title: Underline navigation
examples.description: Use an understated active indicator; long tab lists scroll at narrow widths.
examples.source:
<script setup lang="ts">
import Tabs from "@/components/ui/Tabs.vue";
import { ref } from "vue";
import { Code2, Eye } from "@lucide/vue";

const activeTab = ref("preview");
const items = [
  { id: "preview", label: "Tab placeholder 01", icon: Eye },
  { id: "source", label: "Tab placeholder 02", icon: Code2 },
];
</script>

<template>
  <Tabs id="component-view" v-model="activeTab" :items="items" label="Tabs placeholder" type="underline">
    <template #preview>Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet.</template>
    <template #source>Consectetur adipiscing elit.</template>
  </Tabs>
</template>
